interruption: Automatic approval review unavailable due to a usage limit from 11:52 UTC. Started held-out workers completed by 12:14 UTC. User authorized continuation; final validation resumed after 14:11 UTC.

selection.reason: Both meet held-out completion/body-margin floor. Prefer higher completion in mixed and nominal conditions and lower compute p99 to adaptive acceleration, accepting less paired speed gain.
selection.note: Original four-hour deadline elapsed during usage-limit interruption. Continuation authorized by user; complete outstanding validation without retuning.

controller_status: Optional simulation candidate; default not changed

runtime_diagnosis.conclusion: Observed 175ms peak dominated by generation-2 Python garbage collection (~170ms), not MPC solve. This does not explain all completion failures.

condition_repeats: Each geometry repeats under three conditions, not three new independent tracks.

conditions.nominal: Unchanged course physics/observations, no injected noise or thrust reduction or extra queue.
conditions.one: Extra 20ms queue; .30deg quaternion noise, .06rad/s rate noise; thrust multiplier .98 decreasing to .90 over 11s.
conditions.mixed: Extra queue 0/20ms selected in 15-tick blocks, 60% delayed; same noise/thrust reduction.

limits.handout: Sections 2/3/Table1 rigid-body/mass/inertia/actuator relationships; Section4 smooth feasible trajectories.

verification: 46 installed component/regression tests passed; 100 symbolic problem comparisons had zero error; 120 replay races had identical command hashes.
limitations: Simulation completion uses the official five-gate result; body-angle checks are separate engineering screens.
Measured CPU deadline tests are additional stress conditions, not the official leaderboard or actual drone-computer timing.
Nominal rotor constraints approximate inner-loop behavior; they cannot guarantee unsaturated real motors.
Telemetry is sampled at 50 Hz. Hardware calibration, Vicon loss, radio dropouts, lab boundary and post-finish braking tests remain outstanding.
Thirty-two fresh geometry seeds give wide confidence intervals; sample rates are not population guarantees.
PPO weights, course physics/randomization/sensor range and original default controller entry were unchanged.
The five-second full-lap goal was not reached.
frozen_manifest_note: Frozen repository hashes describe the pre-export baseline. Exact originals are archived in original_controller. Current optional-entry source hashes are recorded separately in source_sha256.
exploratory_decisions: Aggressive reference/route acceleration candidates were rejected after actual body-angle excursions or completion losses.
Full SQP with rotor constraints was rejected for approximately 200ms P99 compute despite promising physics.
Asynchronous dynamic replanning and minimum-derivative smoothing prototypes were not adopted because they did not establish a robust paired speed improvement.
The fixed RTI/drag candidate was retained as an optional experiment; subsequent stress tracks revealed unresolved delayed-command tracking and GC timing failures.
